headline: '700 Million Won Performance Bonus' SK Hynix: Agreement to Pay 60% in Treasury Shares
summary: SK Hynix labor and management have provisionally agreed on wages and collective bargaining terms. The deal pays 60% of profit sharing in treasury shares and 40% in cash, according to industry sources.
why: SK Hynix is a major South Korean memory chip maker and a key supplier to global technology companies. Employee compensation and share buybacks or distributions affect its capital structure and labor relations.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: The provisional labor agreement sets how profit sharing is paid, partly in treasury shares, which affects shareholders and staff pay.
